meta.name: diffdock
meta.description: DiffDock and DiffDock-L molecular docking. Use for protein-small-molecule pose prediction from PDB or sequence plus SMILES/SDF/MOL2, batch docking, virtual screening, and pose-confidence interpretation. Not for binding affinity prediction.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 预测药物分子怎样结合蛋白质
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在药物研发中需要判断化合物如何结合靶蛋白。
copy.tagline_en: Predict how drug molecules bind to proteins
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work on drug discovery and need to see how small molecules bind to a target protein.

howto.what: Claude 会调用 DiffDock 做分子对接:输入蛋白(PDB 或序列)与配体(SMILES/SDF/MOL2),输出 3D 结合构象与置信度评分,支持批量。它不预测结合亲和力。
howto.when: 当你要求把配体对接到蛋白、预测结合构象或结合位点,或做虚拟筛选、批量对接时触发。不用于结合亲和力预测。

say.text: 把 protein.pdb 和这个 SMILES 对接,给出结合构象和置信度。
say.note: 运行单复合物对接并写出结果目录

say.text: 分析 results/batch/,按置信度排序列出头部构象。
say.note: 打印置信度统计与排序结果

howto.what_en: Claude runs DiffDock molecular docking: given a protein (PDB or sequence) and a ligand (SMILES/SDF/MOL2), it outputs 3D binding poses with confidence scores, and can batch process. It does not predict binding affinity.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to dock a ligand to a protein, predict a binding pose or site, or run virtual screening or batch docking. Not for binding affinity prediction.

say_en.text: Dock this SMILES to protein.pdb and give me the poses with confidence scores.
say_en.note: Runs single-complex inference and writes an output dir

say_en.text: Run batch docking with batch_input.csv into results/batch/.
Analyze results/batch/ and rank poses by confidence.
say_en.note: Prints confidence summary and top predictions
